text: In Paris, Maureen buys clothes and jewellery for a supermodel while [waiting for a sign from her dead twin brother|who_suffers|the grieving], as they promised each other before his heart gave out. A night in his empty house brings running taps and [a spirit that vomits ectoplasm|threat|the restless dead]. Then an unknown sender begins texting her, urging her to [wear her employer's forbidden dresses|images|clothes, jewellery and keepsakes], until [a body on a bloodied bathroom floor|wrong|a life taken] leaves her unsure whether the messages come from the living or the dead.
